notes.title: Update notes for 04 12 2021
notes.content:
Snatch Media Toolbox Version 1.3.3.1103

Please see the updates on Setting/About menu tab.

notes.title: Snatch Media Toolbox Update 1.2.1278.0751
notes.content:
Fixed and improved numerous items within SMT to ensure stability, reliability and quality.

Fixed Font size on GiPlayer buttons
Fixed Playlist capitalisation on GifPlayer
Corrected Hyphen position on GifPlayer
Fixed Network Monitor
Fixed Music Playlist Filenames
Improved Track title Searches
Extended audio bar
Improved network checks
Improved the GifPlayer to run async with Music Playlist
GifPlayer shows current playlist name and track name


See updates in Snatch/About Tab

Please do let me know if you have any issues.

notes.title: Snatch Media Toolbox November version 1.2.1188.1518
notes.content:
Major updates since previous download, I have managed to fix a good few bugs I have found, but thankfully Snatch appears to be very stable at the moment. Do get in touch if you find any issues.

Latest fixes and updates:

Improved SMT start up routine on initial installation
Extended Radio list and Playlist dropdown menu for long titles
Added 46 global radio stream links on initial startup
Added ability to search large Music playlists
Added Gifplayer ability to Music playlists
Added a few more extra gifs

notes.title: Snatch Media Toolbox Version 1.2.551.1108
notes.content:
Please backup your stations and playlist as this new update stores all preference files in Music\Snatch folder. This will stop Snatch Updates overwriting your settings, stations and playlist. Snatch will no longer be providing links to Online Radio Stations. Sorry for the inconvenience. But this is a much cleaner and improved solution.

This version includes a step-by-step Help.pdf file to assist with downloading M3U files of your choice and adding them to Snatch. Any issues, please get in touch. Here https://steamcommunity.com/app/1716280/discussions/

notes.title: Snatch 1.2.259.1736

notes.title: Snatch Media Toolbox
notes.content:
Just to let you guys know that a preview build is available version 1.0.4172.1214. You can find it by right clicking on snatch in your library and clicking on Properties. 

Select the BETAS tab and select Preview - Public Beta Version

You can always switch back to the stable version by selecting  the BETAS tab and select 'None'.

You can read the fixes and updates by running Snatch, click on the Settings Tab, then the About Tab, and finally clicking on the Updates button.

Please, please... any issues then do let me know. 

Cheers...

notes.title: News
notes.content:
I have decided to Release Snatch Media Toolbox from Early Access, simply due to a high demand for its use inside and outside of the steam platform. In its current state I am confident that Snatch is stable enough to work on most Windows platforms. Obviously any issues, let me know and I will get back to you.

I will still be adding new functions to Snatch, that existing owners will automatically get for free.

Please do not purchase any keys outside Steam as they will not work. I have not sold or given any keys away to be sold. Please come to me first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41159485/714735de4ecfb5244a1da9ee5150c673fa29ef57.png[/img]

[b]Word is out! that Snatch is being broadcast by users on Twitch and Twitter!  [/b]

Well you can do the same too, just make sure you follow the rules and regulations of broadcasting in your country. Have a great party with your friends and subscribers!!!

notes.title: Snatch Media Toolbox Update 1.0.3950.0618
notes.content: I have updated Snatch Media Toolbox with a couple of updates that add a new tab called In-Game and rearranged the Main Tabs. Hopefully this should fix an issue we were having with downloading Snatch and the folder appearing empty.

notes.title: Software Testers Wanted!
notes.content:
I need a small number of beta testers for the Snatch Media Toolbox who are prepared to provide honest detailed feed back whilst using the software. I also have a small number of keys available for the chosen few that want to help me get this software to a stable and reliable release. 

Please leave your details and I will get back to you as soon as Steam has reviewed the software package. 

Looking forward to hearing from you and working with you.

John Henderson (Dev)
